bullets.text: Corporation officials trying to prevent encroachments in the Pallikaranai marshland in Velachery were driven away by a mysterious group.
A family in Thirumazhisai faced a long wait for last rites because of a crematorium power outage.
Velachery continues to flood despite extensive drainage infrastructure covering most of its road network.
Passengers are facing difficulties as suburban trains operating up to St. Thomas Mount fail to stop at Adambakkam.
South India Shopping Mall has expanded its retail footprint by opening a grand new store in Dandeeswaram, Velachery.
Small rains in Thiruvallur, Gummidipoondi and Thiruvalangadu caused snapped wires and power cuts with slow repair work due to staff shortages.
Over 3,000 streetlights in Avadi remain non-functional despite a maintenance contract, leaving roads poorly lit during rains.
The Central Crime Branch of Avadi City Police arrested a man for cheating four persons of ₹1.32 crore on the promise of government jobs.
Vultr is set to deploy a 20MW AMD AI Supercluster in Chennai, boosting regional infrastructure.
Reliance Jio has proposed a ₹1,350 crore investment for an AI data centre complex at Siruseri SIPCOT IT Park.
An IIT Madras white paper warns that AI could threaten entry-level jobs in BPOs, IT and banking.
Sunil Kumar Gupta will spearhead investment, solar and AI initiatives at the Vibrant Goa Global Business Summit 2026.
The Vice-President urged medical institutions to strengthen research and embrace emerging healthcare technologies.
